auditor: analytical-auditor (Sonnet, blind: claim and data paths only; the tool and the result were not read)
verdict: accept (minor revise: the wording of the moving test and the moving-rows-only dry definition are disclosed)

reproduced.floor_20_drives_10_days: fails: A1 prime is counts only
reproduced.agreement: counts exact; estimate within 0.0003; interval ends within 0.001

concerns_and_disclosures: the moving test needs 'the nearest Trip row with a non-missing displayed speed within 20 s'; taking the literally nearest row even when its speed is missing gives 10 wet, 18 isolated and 213 dry (one drive moves from isolated to dry); the wet, strict, code-6, fuel-basis and eligible counts are unchanged
dry and isolated are defined on moving rows only: 12 dry drives carry on-codes on stopped rows; counting any on-row in the window gives 201 dry and 30 non-episode drives
the wet exclusion in the dark contrast uses the M771 share definition (outcome-free); the span-rule version listed in the spec as a sensitivity was not run (deviation)
no outcome is used in the wiper, episode or soak definitions; fuel is read only for the contrast and the fuel-basis counts
the soak gap runs over the full master including outlier and cloud-less drives, with the first drive unknown; unlogged driving makes it over-label long soaks
the auditor ran no planted-stream tests of its own; the agreement is on real data
